title: "Could not find a package configuration file provided by" in ROS 2 colcon build: five causes on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical, measured
excerpt: What causes the CMake find_package error in an ament_cmake package: a package missing from package.xml (rosdep reports success and installs nothing), apt-get update skipped in Docker, /opt/ros not sourced, eigen3 vs Eigen3, and an undeclared workspace package. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
